{{nihongo|'''Okanoue Shrine'''|岡上神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

{{wikidata link|Q48758325|ja|岡上神社|grok=none|check_date=2026-06-05}}

'''Okanoue Shrine''' (おかのうえじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} enshrined in {{ill|Itano, Tokushima|Q1350904|qid=Q1350904}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}.

=== History ===
Its year of foundation is unknown. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} listed in the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}''. In {{ill|1789|Q7772|qid=Q7772}} (Kansei 1), it moved to the current site.

It is said that {{ill|Minamoto no Yoshitsune|Q310445|qid=Q310445}} worshipped here and prayed for lasting military fortune while heading from landing at Katsuura in {{ill|Awa Province (Tokushima)|Q907457|qid=Q907457}} to {{ill|Yashima|Q11465681|qid=Q11465681}} in {{ill|Sanuki Province|Q929682|qid=Q929682}}. There is also a theory that "Okanoue" was originally read "Okanokami," and is a corruption of "Uka no kami."

Within the precincts stands a {{ill|Camphora officinarum|Q158722|qid=Q158722}} called "Ōkusu of Okanomiya," designated a Tokushima Prefectural Natural Monument. It has long been called the "Sacred Mirror Tree." With a girth of about 25 m, its trunk splits from one root into three, and one of those splits again, so four trunks stand side by side as if pressing against each other.

=== Access ===
* About 5 minutes by car from {{ill|Itano interchange|Q11105197|qid=Q11105197}} on the {{ill|Tokushima Expressway|Q11490216|qid=Q11490216}}.
* About 10 minutes on foot from {{ill|Itano Station|Q8190673|qid=Q8190673}} on the {{ill|Kōtoku Line|Q859984|qid=Q859984}} of {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|Q496531|qid=Q496531|lt=JR}}.
